CustomField.label: Slot Status
CustomField.description: PLACEHOLDER VALUES PENDING BUSINESS CONFIRMATION (LLD Section 7.4 / Section 20 Item 6). System-managed; set by DVC_TourSlotGenerationService. Open = capacity greater than zero; Closed = guide-occupied or lunch-blocked (capacity zero). Business has floated "Available"/"Booked" as an alternative - if adopted, this picklist and all Apex/LWC references to "Open"/"Closed" must be updated together.
